name: pr-stacks
description: A pane that shows the open pull requests of a repository as stacks: base branches, CI and merge status, conflicts, the thread that owns each, and what is ready to merge.

repo.title: Repository
repo.description: owner/name of the repository to watch

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the pane reloads by itself; 0 turns it off

ownersFile.title: Owners file
ownersFile.description: A JSON object that names the threads: branch token or thread id -> name
